hooks.text: 把街机第一人称射击包装成九十年代保龄球馆动画，在地狱球道里用枪与保龄球争夺Kingpin王冠
hooks.excerpt: Sparedevil is an arcade FPS with the graphic charm of classic '90s bowling alley animations. This single-player skirmish is all about skill, strategy, and speed as you aim to dominate the leaderboard and earn the crown as the Kingpin of Hell’s Alley.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 击飞完整十瓶形成Strike、补中残瓶形成Spare，连续成功可从D级升到S级并获得五倍分数乘区
hooks.excerpt: Send all ten pins in a formation flying and that's a Strike ! A pin or two short on your first shot? Follow it up with another roll to take down the stragglers and land a Spare ! Rank Up Combos: start out at a lowly “D” then hit those strikes and spares consistently and you’ll rapidly ascend the ranks. “S” rank bowlers will be rewarded with a hefty 5x multiplier on their score but only the fastest will have the tempo to keep it.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 八种反派球瓶拥有独立行为，火箭瓶会追击、迫击炮瓶持续轰炸、Joker瓶死亡时破坏连击
hooks.excerpt: Put your balls on the line against a roster of 8 uniquely villainous pins ! Each designed with individual behaviors and abilities with their soul purpose bent on ruining your score! Some of the fiends you will be facing include... Flying rocket pins that will chase you down! Mortar pins that will relentlessly barrage your location! Joker pins that when struck down destroy your precious combos!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
